## Summary

**Miguel Rosato, CEng FEI**
Completions & Workover Engineering Lead — Basra Energy Company Limited (BP/CNPC JV), Rumaila Field, Iraq.
Madrid, Spain. Italian citizen. Trilingual (English, Italian, Spanish).

Twenty-five years of operator-side experience in onshore and offshore (subsea and platform) well completions, workover, DST and well-test design. Specialised in HPHT completions, deepwater subsea completions, and mature-field workover programme management. Currently completing a Professional Certificate in Data Analytics at Imperial College London (May 2026).

## Selected technical experience

- **HPHT completions and DST** — including 14,500 psi / 380°F (Maersk Oil Culzean, UK CNS), HPHT carbonate completions (Petronas Carigali, Malaysia), and deepwater HPHT (Reliance / BP, KG-D6, Bay of Bengal).
- **Subsea deepwater completions** — open-hole and cased-hole alternate-path gravel-pack sand control, 6th-generation drillship operations.
- **Workover programme management at scale** — Rumaila Field 2024–2025: +39% throughput at constant rig count, +142,000 bbl/d incremental recovery, ~US$100M CAPEX/OPEX savings, rig-move time reduced 3 → 1 days.
- **Material selection** — 13Cr, super-13Cr, 25Cr duplex, Inconel grades, sour-service NACE/ISO 15156 compliance.
- **Tubular stress analysis** — HPHT load cases including thermal cycling, ballooning, helical buckling, fatigue.
- **Contract experience** — tender evaluation across completions, ESPs, well heads, DST-TCP, coiled tubing, stimulation, well testing, WBCO and slickline services.
- **Project management** — schedule organisation for design, appraise, contract strategy, procurement, and execution of HPHT well-appraisal campaigns.
- **HSE** — risk assessment, multidisciplinary well-on-paper exercises, peer review of operations plans, pre-job safety meetings, after-action reviews.
- **Logging** — open-hole and cased-hole logging, interpretation, and pipeline networking design.
